changes.text: The mogi screen shows which tracks to vote for: green for good, yellow for mixed, red for bad, with the ones already raced struck through. Tracks › Sort can hide it and saves a default order with Make Default.
The race sheet lists that race's screenshots. Remove one to recount the race; Undo brings it back.
Races whose screenshots disappeared after fixing names in Players show them again; results stay the same.
Watched folders can add new screenshots without asking: turn on Add Without Asking in Settings › Watched Folders.
On a laptop trackpad, swiping again turns to the next race without moving the pointer first.
Unlinking a name in Players removes it from every race and forgets the in-game name it learned, so swapped teammates no longer mix their points.
When the room reopens mid-mogi, its first results screen starts the new room, even mid-animation, and saved mogis number their races correctly again.
Answering “Which race is this?” moves the screenshot to that race instead of leaving it under both.
When players or teams tie for first, the mogi header and the mogi list name all of them.
